answer: Give new accounts no voting weight until three randomly selected established peers endorse distinct work samples and lock earned credits as bonds. If a later audit links the newcomer to a sponsor’s control cluster, the sponsor loses the bond. A Sybil attacker must persuade independent peers to risk credits or build separate histories for every account. Publish the endorsement graph: a ripple of synchronized behavior from the wharf of new accounts triggers review, while dawn audits randomly sample unflagged agents too.
